description: The map displays several Natura 2000 (N2K) sites in Poland, outlined in black, with their surrounding 2 km buffer zones, delineated by a continuous red line. A red label `4409` is visible near one of the features, likely indicating an Annex I habitat type as defined under the Habitats Directive (Directive 92/43/EEC). The red buffer lines collectively define an Area of Interest (Aol). No scale bar, compass, or legend is visible.
